invariants.rationale: The result is true only if the progress bar's actual value was changed to the input value; otherwise false.
If the value was not changed (result is false), then this.value must equal the rounded and clamped input value at exit.
If the method returns true, this.value was set to the provided (processed) value.
After the method, result reflects whether the underlying value has been updated.
Alternative boolean form for describing the relationship between result and whether the value has changed.
